name: Allie Ball
occupation: Community Leader; Public Policy Advocate; Communications Professional; Front Desk, Eastside Athletic Club

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Ball lists her occupation as community leader, public policy advocate, communications professional and front desk worker at Eastside Athletic Club.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Community Leader; Public Policy Advocate; Communications Professional; Front Desk, Eastside Athletic Club

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

bio.statement: Ball's pamphlet statement lists prior governmental experience on the Milwaukie Public Safety Advisory Committee and as an elected Precinct Committee Person.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Milwaukie Public Safety Advisory Committee; Elected Precinct Committee Person

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Ball says she will work to expand housing options so working people can afford to live in Milwaukie.
positions.excerpt: Keep Milwaukie Affordable: Expand our housing options ensuring working people can afford to live, stay, and build their future here.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Ball says she will make city finances and decisions easier to understand and give residents a voice in how the city grows.
positions.excerpt: Put Transparency First: Make city finances and decisions easier to understand and more accessible while giving residents a voice in how our city grows.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Ball says she will invest in safe sidewalks, streets, parks and transit and pursue a more community-centered public safety approach.
positions.excerpt: Invest in safe, accessible sidewalks, streets, parks, transit, and public spaces while building a more community-centered public safety approach.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Ball says she will support small businesses and strengthen the local economy.
positions.excerpt: Support our small businesses and strengthen the local economy so residents and entrepreneurs can thrive.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 35 (printed C-34)

positions.statement: On her campaign website's priorities page, Ball states a housing goal that Milwaukie be a place residents can afford to call home.
positions.excerpt: Milwaukie should be a place you can afford to call home.
